References that do not inform the identification

Source: R/uninformative.R
uninformative_references.Rd

The table of reference sequences that parallel_blast() sets aside when ranking the hits: sequences of uncultured or unidentified organisms, metagenomes and MAGs, environmental samples, synthetic constructs and vectors, chimeras, and specific references known to be wrong. Their taxid says little about the query (often only "Bacteria" or "environmental samples"), so a hit to one of them should not decide the identification when a hit to a named organism is also there.

Each row is a rule:

  • field: "header" (pattern is a Perl regular expression, matched against the subject header; use (?i:...) groups for case, as the rules are joined with "|") or "accession" (pattern is a subject accession, with or without version).

  • category: the reason, reported in uninformative_category.

  • note: free text.

Organisms named only at a high rank or in open nomenclature (e.g. "Bacterium", "Picea sp.") are not here: their lineage is right, only shallow. blast_lca() sets them aside when a named species is tied with them.

Usage

uninformative_references(x = NULL)

Arguments

x

NULL (default) for the table shipped with BLASTr, a path to a tab-separated file with the same columns, or a data frame.

Value

A tibble with field, pattern, category and note, with the attribute md5 (of its content, to record which table was used).

See also

Other result functions: as_blast_long(), blast_lca(), blast_summary(), check_hits(), similarity_score()

Examples

uninformative_references()
#> # A tibble: 14 × 4
#>    field     pattern                                              category note 
#>    <chr>     <chr>                                                <chr>    <chr>
#>  1 header    "(?i:uncultured)"                                    uncultu… uncu…
#>  2 header    "^MAG"                                               metagen… meta…
#>  3 header    "(?i:metagenome)"                                    metagen… meta…
#>  4 header    "(?i:\\benvironmental (sample|DNA)\\b)"              environ… envi…
#>  5 header    "^Leaf litter"                                       environ… envi…
#>  6 header    "16S rRNA amplicon fragment"                         environ… envi…
#>  7 header    "Complete LGCome-Assembled"                          environ… envi…
#>  8 header    "root endophyte"                                     environ… envi…
#>  9 header    "root associated fungus"                             environ… envi…
#> 10 header    "(?i:synthetic construct)"                           synthet… synt…
#> 11 header    "(?i:\\b(cloning|expression|shuttle|transformation|… synthet… vect…
#> 12 header    "(?i:\\bunidentified\\b)"                            unident… unid…
#> 13 header    "(?i:\\bchimeric\\b)"                                chimeric chim…
#> 14 accession "XR_004027927.1"                                     bad ref… PRED…
